items.question: Can agencies manage many client accounts from Dealup?
items.answer: Yes. Each client account gets its own organized shared inbox inside the same platform, with per-account assignment and routing so conversations stay separate and accountable.

items.question: Can I reuse Flows and campaigns across accounts?
items.answer: Yes. Approved templates, Flows and automations can be adapted and deployed across client accounts instead of rebuilt from scratch for each one.

items.question: How does support coverage work across clients?
items.answer: AI answers FAQs and qualifies leads automatically, urgency and assignment rules are set per client, and full conversation history stays attached per account.

items.question: Can we hand conversations back to a client's team cleanly?
items.answer: Yes. Shared inboxes allow smooth assignment between agency and client-side teammates, with the full conversation history following the handoff.

items.question: How do agencies report on results?
items.answer: Campaign and support metrics are available per account and can be exported or incorporated into your agency's client reporting.
